note: Phase-0 COVERAGE DENOMINATOR (plan 2026-07-26 v3). The defence-in-depth map can only judge endpoints the ENFORCEMENT POINT actually routes — verdicts are taken at Kong (decision 0010: 'authorization enforcement is Kong ACL'), never at the app's direct publish port. A red-team proved that probing the app origin instead measures around the control and manufactures findings. Derived from infra/kong/kong.rendered.yml; regenerate when the gateway config changes.
coverage_bound: 8 routed endpoints. The app's real surface is far larger, so results describe the GATEWAY-FRONTED slice only and must never be read as whole-app coverage.

routes.name: basket-write
routes.skip_reason: state-changing verb — out of scope for the read-only map (decision 0016)

synthetic_canary.note: A path the gateway does NOT route. It must classify as `not-routed` on every run. It is SYNTHETIC on purpose: a canary that is a real finding would stop firing the moment the system is fixed, permanently breaking the run (red-team F6). This canary proves the prober is reaching the enforcement point and classifying, without depending on any vulnerability existing.

session_canary.note: An endpoint the ACL is KNOWN to allow for agent-recon. It must return 2xx with a minted token before any verdict is trusted: without a live identity every gateway reply is 401 and every endpoint would look protected (red-team H1's silent-failure mode).
